However we have evidence that The Rescuers Down Under is a sequel to the 1977 animated film "The Rescuers". That indicates The Rescuers was released earlier (1977). The Muppets soundtrack is for the musical comedy film "The Muppets" released presumably 2011. Evidence: soundtrack released November 22, 2011 for the film "The Muppets". So The Rescuers (1977) earlier than The Muppets (2011). Answer: The Rescuers.
